newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore, Malaysia in joint air defence drill.
newsitem.headline: Singapore, Malaysia in joint air defence drill.

text.p: Singapore and Malaysia will hold a one-day joint air defence exercise to hone their ability to defend their airspace, the Singapore Ministry of Defence said on Tuesday.

"The aim of Minor Adex 97 is to exercise together the air defence forces of the two regional member nations in preserving the integrity of the Malaysian and Singapore air space against a simulated external air threat," a ministry statement said.
The exercise will be held on Wednesday and will involve a variety of aircraft, including Russian MIG 29 fighters on the Malaysian side and U.S.-made F-16 fighters from the Singapore Air Force.
